# omp-webui

> A web UI and macOS app for the omp coding agent: browse and search every conversation, branch from any message, watch subagents live, see token usage and cost, guard dangerous commands, reach it remotely through a Cloudflare tunnel, and run every omp command from the browser. The agent-facing docs below describe each feature, where it is in the UI, every setting (key, values, default, effect) and the server's API routes with which are local-only.

The docs are English only, by choice. Agents running inside omp-webui read the same files through the read-only `webui_docs` tool (`xd://webui_docs`). Setting keys are fully qualified: `ompw.*` web UI preferences, `guard.json:*`, `remote.json:*` and `mode.json:*` files of the data folder (`~/.omp-webui`), `session:*` session defaults, `omp:*` omp settings.

- [Appearance and layout](docs/agents/appearance.md): theme, palette, language, widths, side panel panes, sidebar pages

- [The message box](docs/agents/composer.md): sending, steering, attachments, quick prompts, side questions, goals
- [Session controls and permission mode](docs/agents/session-controls.md): the This session panel, defaults, permission modes, the Loaded dialog
- [Compaction](docs/agents/compaction.md): when a conversation compacts, and where a queued compact runs
- [Agent graph and subagents](docs/agents/agent-graph.md): the agent graph page and the Agents tab
- [Notifications](docs/agents/notifications.md): page notifications and Web Push
- [Unattended mode and questions](docs/agents/unattended.md): working while the person is away, and their questions
- [Quota and usage](docs/agents/quota-and-usage.md): provider quota, the quota floor, waiting for a reset, Usage & cost
- [Projects, folders and git](docs/agents/projects-and-git.md): the projects folder, project groups, git status and worktrees
- [Feedback](docs/agents/feedback.md): sending feedback and the star prompt
- [Guard dangerous commands](docs/agents/guard.md): the reviewer gate for risky tool calls
- [Remote access](docs/agents/remote-access.md): Cloudflare tunnel and Access, what a remote page may do
- [Files tab and file transfer](docs/agents/file-transfer.md): browsing, editing, downloading and uploading a conversation's files
- [Models, roles, presets and accounts](docs/agents/models.md): provider logins, model roles, presets, favourites
- [Model guidance](docs/agents/model-guidance.md): standing instructions on which models subagents use
- [Memory](docs/agents/memory.md): what omp remembers, and the Memory page
- [Full / Light mode](docs/agents/light-mode.md): lighter conversations and local model servers
- [Updates of the app and of omp](docs/agents/updates.md): checking, installing and dismissing updates
- [The macOS app](docs/agents/macos-app.md): quitting, the menu bar icon, keeping the Mac awake, windows onto other Macs
- [Move to another computer](docs/agents/migration.md): export and import of conversations and settings
- [The server and its security](docs/agents/server-and-security.md): data folder, access token, network address, local-only routes, environment variables
- [The webui_docs tool](docs/agents/webui-docs-tool.md): the read-only lookup tool agents use to read these docs
